title: Zyxel security advisory (AV26-780)
description: As of August 4, 2026, Zyxel is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
ATP series firmware
	from V4.32 through V5.42 Patch 1

USG FLEX 50(W) series firmware
	from V4.16 through V5.42 Patch 1

USG FLEX series firmware
	from V4.50 through V5.42 Patch 1

USG20(W)-VPN series firmware
	from V4.16 through V5.42 Patch 1

WAX650S firmware
	Prior to or equal to 7.10(ABRM.4)C0
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
